meta.note: The DCA's guide, as summarised by a search, says to keep drones away from airports, heliports, military bases and other restricted areas, specifically within 5 km. This circle is 5 km from the centre of every airport in the open data; heliports and military bases are not shown, so it is only a guide. Ask the DCA for the real areas.
